description: This file contains functions for computing similarity match scores between resumes and job descriptions, as well as providing suggestions for resume improvements based on basic rules.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a: List[str], b: List[str])
methods.description: Computes the Jaccard similarity coefficient between two lists of strings.

methods.name: Tuple[float,Dict] compute_match(resume_parsed: Dict, job_parsed: Dict)
methods.description: Calculates a weighted match score between resume and job parsed data with an explanation.

methods.name: List[Dict] generate_suggestions(resume_text: str, resume_parsed: Dict, job_text: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Provides ATS-like resume improvement suggestions based on simple rules.

ctags.name: compute_match
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_match(resume_parsed: Dict, job_parsed: Dict) -> Tuple[float, Dict]:$/

ctags.name: generate_suggestions
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_suggestions(resume_text: str, resume_parsed: Dict, job_text: Optional[str] = None) /
ctags.signature: (resume_text: str, resume_parsed: Dict, job_text: Optional[str] = None)
